# VENDOR SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Vendor Services Agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of February 1, 2025 (the "Effective Date"), by and between:

**GlobalRetail Corporation**, a Delaware corporation with principal offices at 500 Retail Plaza, Chicago, IL 60601 ("Client"),

and

**TechVendor Solutions, Inc.**, a California corporation with principal offices at 200 Innovation Way, San Jose, CA 95110 ("Vendor").

Client and Vendor may be referred to individually as a "Party" or collectively as the "Parties."

## RECITALS

WHEREAS, Client desires to engage Vendor to provide certain IT consulting and implementation services as described herein;

WHEREAS, Vendor represents that it has the expertise and resources to perform such services;

NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants contained herein, the Parties agree as follows:

## ARTICLE I - SCOPE OF WORK

### 1.1 Services
Vendor shall provide the services described in Exhibit A (the "Services"). Any changes to the Services must be agreed upon in writing through a Change Order as specified in Section 2.4.

### 1.2 Performance Standards
Vendor shall perform the Services in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards.

### 1.3 Personnel
Vendor shall assign qualified personnel to perform the Services. Client may request replacement of any Vendor personnel with reasonable cause.

## ARTICLE II - DELIVERABLES AND ACCEPTANCE

### 2.1 Deliverables
Vendor shall deliver the deliverables specified in Exhibit A (each, a "Deliverable") according to the timeline in Section 4.

### 2.2 Delivery
Each Deliverable shall be delivered to Client's project manager or designated representative.

### 2.3 Acceptance Criteria
Client shall have fifteen (15) business days to review each Deliverable (the "Review Period"). If Client does not provide written notice of rejection within the Review Period, the Deliverable shall be deemed accepted.

### 2.4 Rejection and Cure
If a Deliverable is rejected, Vendor shall have thirty (30) days to cure the deficiency at no additional cost to Client.

### 2.5 Change Orders
Any changes to the Services or Deliverables must be documented in a written Change Order signed by both Parties, specifying the impact on fees and timeline.

## ARTICLE III - COMPENSATION

### 3.1 Fees
Client shall pay Vendor the fees specified in Exhibit B. The total estimated value of this Agreement is Two Million Five Hundred Thousand Dollars ($2,500,000).

### 3.2 Invoicing
Vendor shall invoice Client monthly for Services performed and Deliverables completed during the prior month.

### 3.3 Payment Terms
Invoices are payable within forty-five (45) days of receipt. Late payments shall accrue interest at 1% per month or the maximum rate permitted by law.

### 3.4 Expenses
Client shall reimburse Vendor for pre-approved out-of-pocket expenses at actual cost. Travel expenses shall not exceed the amounts specified in Exhibit B without prior written approval.

### 3.5 Taxes
Each Party is responsible for its own taxes. Fees do not include sales, use, or value-added taxes.

## ARTICLE IV - TIMELINE AND MILESTONES

### 4.1 Project Duration
The project shall commence on the Effective Date and continue until completion or termination as specified herein.

### 4.2 Milestones
| Milestone | Description | Due Date | Payment % |
|-----------|-------------|----------|-----------|
| M1 | Requirements Analysis Complete | April 15, 2025 | 15% |
| M2 | Design Phase Complete | June 30, 2025 | 20% |
| M3 | Development Complete | September 30, 2025 | 30% |
| M4 | Testing Complete | November 15, 2025 | 20% |
| M5 | Final Acceptance | December 31, 2025 | 15% |

### 4.3 Delays
If Vendor causes a delay in any Milestone exceeding fifteen (15) business days, Client may assess liquidated damages of $5,000 per business day of delay, not to exceed five percent (5%) of the total fees.

## ARTICLE V - REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES

### 5.1 Mutual Representations
Each Party represents and warrants that: (a) it is duly organized and validly existing under the laws of its jurisdiction; (b) it has full power and authority to enter into this Agreement; (c) this Agreement constitutes a legal and binding obligation.

### 5.2 Vendor Warranties
Vendor represents and warrants that: (a) the Services will be performed in a professional manner; (b) the Deliverables will conform to the specifications; (c) the Deliverables will not infringe any intellectual property rights of any third party; (d) it has the necessary licenses and qualifications to perform the Services.

### 5.3 Warranty Period
Vendor's warranty obligations shall survive for twelve (12) months from the date of Final Acceptance.

### 5.4 Warranty Remedy
If any Deliverable fails to conform to the warranty, Vendor shall, at Client's option, repair or replace the non-conforming Deliverable at no additional cost.

## ARTICLE VI - INDEMNIFICATION

### 6.1 Vendor Indemnification
Vendor shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Client and its affiliates from any third-party claims arising from: (a) Vendor's negligence or willful misconduct; (b) breach of Vendor's representations or warranties; (c) infringement of intellectual property rights by the Deliverables.

### 6.2 Client Indemnification
Client shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Vendor from any third-party claims arising from: (a) Client's use of the Deliverables in a manner not authorized by this Agreement; (b) breach of Client's representations or warranties.

### 6.3 Indemnification Procedures
The indemnified Party shall: (a) promptly notify the indemnifying Party of any claim; (b) permit the indemnifying Party to control the defense; (c) provide reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying Party's expense.

## ARTICLE VII - LIMITATION OF LIABILITY

### 7.1 Consequential Damages
NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE FOR INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES, OR LOST PROFITS OR REVENUES, WHETHER IN AN ACTION FOR BREACH OF CONTRACT, TORT (INCLUDING NEGLIGENCE), OR OTHERWISE.

### 7.2 Liability Cap
EXCEPT FOR BREACHES OF CONFIDENTIALITY OBLIGATIONS, INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, OR GROSS NEGLIGENCE/WILLFUL MISCONDUCT, EACH PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY SHALL NOT EXCEED THE TOTAL FEES PAID OR PAYABLE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT.

### 7.3 Essential Basis
The limitations in this Section form an essential basis of the bargain and reflect the allocation of risk between the Parties.

## ARTICLE VIII - CONFIDENTIALITY

### 8.1 Definition
"Confidential Information" means non-public information disclosed by one Party to the other that is designated as confidential or that reasonably should be understood to be confidential.

### 8.2 Obligations
The receiving Party shall: (a) protect Confidential Information using reasonable care; (b) use Confidential Information only for purposes of this Agreement; (c) not disclose Confidential Information except to employees with a need to know.

### 8.3 Duration
Confidentiality obligations shall survive for five (5) years from the date of disclosure.

## ARTICLE IX - INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY

### 9.1 Work Product
All work product, deliverables, and intellectual property created by Vendor in performing the Services shall be "works made for hire" and owned exclusively by Client.

### 9.2 Assignment
To the extent any Work Product does not qualify as a "work made for hire," Vendor hereby assigns all rights, title, and interest in such Work Product to Client.

### 9.3 Vendor Tools
Vendor retains ownership of any pre-existing tools, methodologies, or know-how used in creating the Deliverables ("Vendor Tools"). Vendor grants Client a perpetual, royalty-free license to use any Vendor Tools embedded in the Deliverables.

### 9.4 Client Materials
Client grants Vendor a limited license to use Client's materials, data, and systems solely for performing the Services.

## ARTICLE X - TERM AND TERMINATION

### 10.1 Initial Term
This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and continue until completion of the Services or earlier termination.

### 10.2 Termination for Convenience
Client may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon thirty (30) days prior written notice. In such event, Client shall pay Vendor for Services performed through the termination date plus any non-cancellable commitments.

### 10.3 Termination for Cause
Either Party may terminate this Agreement for material breach if the breaching Party fails to cure such breach within thirty (30) days after written notice specifying the breach.

### 10.4 Effect of Termination
Upon termination: (a) Vendor shall immediately cease work and deliver all completed Work Product; (b) Client shall pay for accepted Deliverables and non-cancellable commitments; (c) each Party shall return or destroy the other's Confidential Information.

## ARTICLE XI - GENERAL PROVISIONS

### 11.1 Governing Law
This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Illinois, without regard to conflict of laws principles.

### 11.2 Dispute Resolution
The Parties shall first attempt to resolve any dispute through good faith negotiation. If unresolved within thirty (30) days, either Party may pursue legal remedies.

### 11.3 Insurance
Vendor shall maintain: (a) Commercial General Liability insurance of at least $2,000,000 per occurrence; (b) Professional Liability/Errors and Omissions insurance of at least $5,000,000 per occurrence; (c) Workers' Compensation as required by law.

### 11.4 Non-Solicitation
During the term and for twelve (12) months thereafter, neither Party shall solicit for employment any employee of the other Party who was involved in this engagement.

### 11.5 Assignment
Vendor may not assign this Agreement without Client's prior written consent. Client may assign this Agreement in connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of substantially all assets.

### 11.6 Subcontracting
Vendor shall not subcontract any portion of the Services without Client's prior written consent.

### 11.7 Entire Agreement
This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties and supersedes all prior agreements relating to the subject matter.

### 11.8 Amendment
This Agreement may only be amended by a written instrument signed by both Parties.

### 11.9 Severability
If any provision is held invalid, the remaining provisions shall continue in full force and effect.

### 11.10 Waiver
Failure to enforce any provision shall not constitute a waiver.

### 11.11 Notices
All notices shall be in writing and delivered by hand, certified mail, or recognized courier service to the addresses listed above.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties have executed this Agreement as of the Effective Date.
